_comment: Relative weights for the structure-aware mutation strategies. Shared by
the in-process C mutator (tools/fuzz/ext4_mutator.c) and the Python
campaign that runs in validation (Tests/fuzz/mutate_image.py), so that
the two instruments aim at the same places and a finding from one is
Weights are relative, not percentages; they are summed and sampled.
raw is deliberately the largest single share: a structure-aware mutator
that never makes an unstructured edit stops finding the bugs that live
